why_reference_matters: Normative baseline for web accessibility decisions.
qualities_to_study: Keyboard, focus, target sizing, contrast and reflow criteria
interaction_principles: Interaction must satisfy applicable keyboard and focus criteria.
visual_principles: Text and meaningful non-text content need the applicable contrast.
ux_principles: Conformance requires evaluating the complete scope, not judging aesthetics.
do_not_copy: Do not replace criteria with a generic accessibility score.
adaptation_to_current_system: Evaluate existing system roles and interactions against applicable AA criteria; repair conflicts through approved semantic roles.
evidence_limits: Specification inspected; no product or runtime conformance tested.

why_reference_matters: Clarifies behavior beyond drawing a dropdown.
interaction_principles: Specify keyboard and focus behavior for the chosen model.
ux_principles: An accessible interaction contract includes semantics and naming.
do_not_copy: Do not add ARIA to replace suitable native controls without need.
adaptation_to_current_system: Map the selected model onto the existing control API; validate its real implementation.
evidence_limits: Pattern document inspected; examples do not prove custom implementation accessibility.

interaction_principles: Modal behavior includes managed focus and an exit path.
do_not_copy: Do not apply modal semantics to a nonmodal comparison panel.
adaptation_to_current_system: Specify focus entry/return and escape behavior using the existing dialog component.
evidence_limits: Pattern document inspected; focus behavior needs browser and assistive-technology testing.

why_reference_matters: Grounds reuse in actual Figma mechanisms.
visual_principles: Reuse the appropriate component rather than recreating its appearance.
do_not_copy: Do not detach instances just to restyle them.
adaptation_to_current_system: Inspect existing library assets and preserve component references before extending them.
evidence_limits: Documentation inspected; no user's Figma file was provided or mutated.

why_reference_matters: Provides configuration mechanisms beyond multiplying variants.
qualities_to_study: Text, visibility, instance swap, variant and slot properties
interaction_principles: Boolean layer visibility can affect prototype structure; inspect behavior.
visual_principles: Use properties matching editable content and configuration.
ux_principles: Expose meaningful controls to component consumers.
do_not_copy: Do not assume every tool or file supports every documented property.
adaptation_to_current_system: Align properties with implementation concepts and confirm supported capabilities.
evidence_limits: Documentation inspected including current property table; tool support and actual component bindings untested.

why_reference_matters: Clarifies typed values and scalable configuration.
visual_principles: Bind supported properties to existing semantic variables.
do_not_copy: Do not force composite styles into a single unsupported variable.
adaptation_to_current_system: Keep stable variable IDs; map semantic roles and inspect mode values.
evidence_limits: Documentation inspected; project bindings and library publishing are untested.

screen_flow: Accessibility: text scaling, input alternatives, labeling and motion
why_reference_matters: First-party accessibility guidance for Apple platform design.
qualities_to_study: Labels, control geometry and motion preferences
interaction_principles: Offer alternatives to gestures and test platform assistive input.
Preserve system keyboard behavior and reduce unwanted motion.
visual_principles: Support larger text and meaningful non-color cues.
ux_principles: Allow user preferences and avoid timed dismissal of necessary information.
do_not_copy: Do not apply a single platform metric to every OS or interpret guidance as a complete app test.
adaptation_to_current_system: Use existing native components and project roles, then verify the target platform's accessibility settings and current controls.
evidence_limits: Landing page was a JavaScript shell. Substantive first-party DocC accessibility JSON was inspected; other HIG topics, rendered examples and an app were not tested.

screen_flow: Table anatomy, selection and batch actions
why_reference_matters: A mature enterprise table contract with task-specific limits.
qualities_to_study: Selection, batch context, expansion and toolbar anatomy
interaction_principles: Batch operations require explicit selected-item context.
ux_principles: Use tables for structured data tasks; do not assume spreadsheet editing.
do_not_copy: Do not import Carbon row sizes, brand, or every modifier.
adaptation_to_current_system: Use local density tokens and table primitives; choose only features required by the task.
evidence_limits: Guidelines inspected; Carbon-specific examples are not a universal table mandate.

qualities_to_study: Names reflect usage, themes change values
visual_principles: Choose tokens for their semantic purpose, not matching current colors.
ux_principles: Stable roles enable coherent theme changes.
do_not_copy: Do not copy Atlassian values or merge distinct meanings because values match.
adaptation_to_current_system: Map roles to existing local tokens and inspect every supported mode.
evidence_limits: Specific token document inspected; no local token library tested.

screen_flow: UI kit tiers, properties and styling variables
why_reference_matters: Connects platform assets, component APIs and code.
qualities_to_study: Core kits versus extensions; global and alias variables
interaction_principles: Component properties map to meaningful code concepts.
visual_principles: Shared variables support styling across platform assets.
do_not_copy: Do not import Microsoft styling into an unrelated product.
adaptation_to_current_system: Preserve project foundations while aligning platform components with actual code contracts.
evidence_limits: Design overview inspected; individual platform components and code libraries not tested.

why_reference_matters: Illustrates behavioral responsibilities of reusable primitives.
qualities_to_study: Accessible labels, expected keys and focus
interaction_principles: Define naming and focus along with keyboard behavior.
ux_principles: Component authors still supply contextual labels.
do_not_copy: Do not assume a composed product passes accessibility because its primitive library is tested.
adaptation_to_current_system: Use the project's implementation library and test the composed behavior.
evidence_limits: Overview inspected; no package version, custom composition or runtime verified.

why_reference_matters: A diagnostic lens for task failures.
qualities_to_study: Status, user control, error prevention and recovery
interaction_principles: Feedback and exits should match the actual system state.
ux_principles: Recognition and understandable recovery reduce avoidable effort.
do_not_copy: Do not treat a heuristic checklist as usability-test results.
adaptation_to_current_system: Apply to concrete task evidence, with severity and a proposed repair.
evidence_limits: Article inspected; heuristics are broad guidance rather than observed user success.

screen_flow: Catalog overview; select a specific shipped flow before extraction
why_reference_matters: Discovery route for shipped screens, flows and interaction references.
qualities_to_study: Task-matched complete flows rather than isolated attractive screenshots
do_not_copy: Do not infer performance, conversion, focus or recovery from catalog listings.
adaptation_to_current_system: Inspect a specific accessible flow and map its logic through the current system.
evidence_limits: Catalog overview inspected; no particular listed product flow was inspected or tested.

screen_flow: Award catalog; specific site to select
why_reference_matters: Discovery route for visual and motion exploration.
do_not_copy: Do not copy brand, inaccessible motion or treat awards as usability evidence.
adaptation_to_current_system: Inspect a selected running site and extract only compatible composition or motion logic.
evidence_limits: Retrieval failed; no site, screenshot or motion sequence inspected.

screen_flow: Award catalog overview; specific site to select
why_reference_matters: Discovery route for high-fidelity web execution.
qualities_to_study: Composition and expressive execution to investigate
do_not_copy: Do not copy award scores as product evidence or assume listed websites are accessible.
adaptation_to_current_system: Inspect the actual site, test relevant behavior, then translate useful principles through project tokens.
evidence_limits: Catalog descriptions inspected; no running awarded site or rendered motion was inspected.

screen_flow: Public payment entry and method-information page
why_reference_matters: A shipped public-service entry integrates action, method choice, timing and recovery information.
interaction_principles: Entry offers an actionable service route and separate method information; this is a content observation.
ux_principles: Place prerequisites and consequential context near the task entry; inferred adaptation from observed content organization.
do_not_copy: Do not copy government branding, tax policy, timing rules or assume downstream payment behavior.
adaptation_to_current_system: Apply task-led information order through local headings, links and service-entry components; use the current product's actual policy.
evidence_limits: Public page text and links inspected. No downstream payment, login, rendered layout, keyboard behavior or transaction was executed.
